items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: The name 'Monk' appears only as the interviewer's name (Monk Rowe). There is no mention of Thelonious Monk or any other person named Monk in the transcript.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a real pleasure to be talking with Dr. Denny Zeitlin this afternoon.
Thanks for fitting us into your — you probably have a busy schedule.
